subject: general
question: Which among the following won the best film (critics') award in the 67th Filmfare Awards 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sardar Udham.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The 67th Filmfare Awards were given out on 30 August 2022 at Jio World Centre, **Mumbai**.
 
• The 67th edition of the awards honored the films released in 2021.
 
• **Sardar Udham **won the **best film (critics)** award at the 67th Filmfare Awards.
 
• Director of Sardar Udha
